summary.text: Sean Brennan is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 14 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher by profession, he is ranking member of the Public Insurance and Pensions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sean Brennan was born in Sandusky, Ohio.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Dayton in 1992 and a graduate degree from Cleveland State University in 2000, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as teaching.
Brennan assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Bride Rose Sweeney.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as ranking member of Public Insurance and Pensions and membership on the House Local Government Committee.
